style: Individual game pictograms in a shared cream, gold, coral, green and ocean-blue palette. Generated artwork; source.png preserves the 256px master.

games.rockies-explorer: two rugged snow-capped Rocky Mountain peaks with one tiny gold trail marker. Navy-blue background, cream snow and muted teal mountains
games.prairie-windrider: a small land yacht with a triangular cream sail, two obvious dark wheels and a sweeping gold prairie wind line. Dark forest-green background
games.arctic-expedition: a warm orange supply crate strapped onto a simple cream sled above a blue ice slab. Deep navy background
games.quebec-bonjour: a blue restaurant plate with a large golden croissant and a tiny cream speech-bubble accent. Deep blue background; no lettering
games.cabot-tower-signals: a golden diamond-shaped kite with a short zigzag tail and three clear cream signal dots underneath. Deep ocean-blue background
games.niagara-currents: one broad turquoise waterfall pouring over a cream cliff with a small golden water-control gate. Deep blue background
games.fundy-tidekeeper: a small cream-and-gold boat lifted on one big rounded turquoise tidal wave. Deep ocean-green background
games.cabot-trail: a gold car seen from above on a single curling cream road with one dark-teal Cape Breton hill. Dark pine-green background
games.confederation-bridge: a bold cream bridge deck with three chunky pillars spanning teal water and a single small orange car. Deep blue background
games.kouchibouguac-cycle: a large golden bicycle with two clear circular cream wheels and one tiny evergreen. Dark forest-green background
games.pei-potato-harvest: two warm golden-brown potatoes with just three eye marks, nestled above a curved terracotta soil patch. Deep forest-green background
games.newfoundland-ferry: a broad white ferry with a gold funnel and two teal waves below, clear simple side profile. Deep ocean-blue background
games.jellybean-row: three tightly packed St John's row houses in coral red, golden yellow and teal with simple cream windows and pitched roofs. Deep navy background
games.canada-roadtrip: a cream instant-photo postcard frame containing two teal mountain peaks and a gold sun, slightly tilted. Deep forest-green background
games.donair-dash: a recognizable Halifax donair in a folded golden pita and white paper wrap, topped with brown shaved meat, red tomato and white sauce; NO lettuce. Deep forest-green background
games.clams-and-chips: a cream paper tray containing golden battered fried clam meat pieces and thick-cut golden chips, NOT clams in shells. Deep teal background
games.shell-shocked: a large bright coral-red lobster claw holding a tiny gold butter droplet. Deep ocean-blue background
games.some-steep-banff: two golden skis crossed in front of a cream snow-capped mountain. Deep navy-blue background
games.wildlife-jam-banff: a bold cream elk head with unmistakable broad antlers rising behind a small orange car bumper. Dark forest-green background
games.kitchen-party-outta-hand: a warm golden teapot tilted as it spills three cream musical notes, playful but simple. Deep forest-green background
games.souwester-survival: a large golden yellow souwester fisherman's rain hat with an extended back brim and two cream raindrops. Deep teal background
games.true-north-turbo: one bold gold lightning bolt through a simple cream maple leaf. Deep navy background
games.coast-to-coast-chaos: a golden serving tray with one cup and one plate leaning in opposite directions, two short cream motion lines. Deep teal background
games.one-more-tune: one large warm golden fiddle with four simple dark strings and one diagonal cream bow. Deep forest-green background
games.double-double-empire: a large cream takeaway coffee cup with golden sleeve and small gold crown above it, no text or commercial logos. Deep brown background
games.great-maritime-gauntlet: one big golden mitten gripping a coral-red lobster claw like a trophy. Deep ocean-blue background
games.some-good-kitchen-party: a cozy cream house with a golden lit window and a large gold music note emerging from the roof. Deep forest-green background
games.trans-canada-trek: a cream compass ring with one gold north-pointing needle and a small teal road curving toward it. Deep navy background
games.keep-er-goin: a large golden kettle with one cream steam curl shaped as a circular restart arrow. Deep forest-green background
games.yes-by: a simple golden wooden lobster trap with a bold coral lobster silhouette visible inside and a cream rope handle. Deep ocean-blue background
games.out-for-a-rip: a cream delivery van with a golden parcel on its roof and two bold gold motion lines. Deep forest-green background
games.maritime-merchant: a cream sailing cargo boat carrying two golden crates above one teal wave. Deep navy background
games.kitchen-party-tycoon: a golden kitchen table with two cream mugs and a small gold upward arrow behind it. Deep forest-green background
games.east-coast-mayhem: a coral lobster claw bursting through a single cream-and-gold comic starburst. Deep ocean-blue background
games.fog-over-fundy: a cream lighthouse casting one broad golden beam above two simple teal fog bands. Deep navy background
games.last-boat: a cream wooden tour boat with a gold cabin on one teal wave, beside a short cream dock piling. Deep ocean-teal background
